_note: Children education allowance, exempt up to a prescribed amount per month per child for at most two children (D-101; rulebook SAL-ALW-PERS-001, H-2). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Rules, 2026 r.280(2) Table Sl. 7 (p.1782): "Children Education Allowance — Whole of India — ₹3000 per month per child up to a maximum of two children"; not in r.280(3)'s list, so not in the new regime. TY 2025-26: Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.2BB(2) Table Sl. 5 (Income Tax Department consolidation, p.4): "Children Education Allowance — Whole of India — Rs. 100 per month per child up to a maximum of two children"; no notification changing the amount between 2011 and 2026 was found; not in r.2BB(3)'s list. The months are entered as a count, so no completed-or-calendar month choice is made (rulebook: NEEDS VERIFICATION). In every regime as a row; the new regime forbids it through DIS-NEW-TAX-REGIME-NO-EXEMPTION, whose basis REG-NEW-TAX-REGIME-NO-EXEMPTION (S2 s.202(2)(a); 1961 s.115BAC(2)(i)) every explanation cites (D-166).
